//lastChange: Health content system (2026-09-08). A fixed library of four articles a pharmacy may opt into, NOT per-pharmacy generation: a model writing health copy for each pharmacy would put unreviewed medical text on a NAFDAC-registered business under its own name, and the assistant refuses to answer clinical questions in WhatsApp for exactly that reason. Publishing requires status APPROVED plus a named reviewer plus a date, checked in one filter that every render path defaults to — so an unreviewed article cannot become a page by any route, and all four ship pending_review with reviewer null. Out of the box a pharmacy can publish none of them, which is correct rather than unfinished. Tests assert the content contains no dosing language, does not diagnose, and always names when to seek care. One real bug surfaced: the home page linked nowhere, because the header block navigation defaults to empty and every generated page was an orphan reachable only by typing its URL.
